key_findings.headline: price_history.db contains 1329 discontinuity events (1142 caused by source changes, 57 tickers show the ADIB alternating-price pattern). Top-20 most-affected tickers are ALL classified INVALID due to source mixing between yahoo_clean and egx_investment_migration. OHLC schema violations: 307743 rows (open/close outside [low, high]). corporate_actions table has 0 per-ticker split/dividend records — no discontinuity can be Confirmed.
